ROUTE: Dunlin-235B
REASON: I chose Dunlin because the query is a friendly, open-ended "explain the benefit" question — exactly the kind of generative/explanatory work Dunlin self-reports a strong preference for (71 win-rate on open-ended generative work). The task is low-stakes and conversational, so the raw capability/benchmark advantages of Willet aren't decisive here, while routing a task to a model that prefers it is a reasonable tiebreaker. There was no harm-adjacent or adversarial element that would argue against Dunlin.
